title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 41,472 Official Dossiers Across 39 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 41,472 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 933 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 39 active jurisdictions: United States (15,455 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (3,045 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,384 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (5,215 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,994 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (187 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,320 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,136 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (190 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (489 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (73 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (77 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (414 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (99 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (93 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (36 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (181 dossiers | Catalog), Bahrain (33 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (43 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (42 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (42 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (47 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (17 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
